title: IS marketplace authoring tier — 4-fold composable $defs
description: Foundation that all six authoring contracts (skill-frontmatter, plugin-manifest, agent-definition, mcp-config, hook-config, marketplace-catalog) inherit. Decomposes the IS marketplace tier into four orthogonal, independently-versioned concerns per plan 033 § 14.10 (closes C3 / F-RH-001 / F-RH-006). The `isMarketplace` $def is the allOf composition of the four folds. Each fold carries its own $comment changelog so a tactical bump (e.g. deprecationRegistry) does not force consumers to re-evaluate an architectural fold (requiredFields). NOTE: the folds are intentionally open-world (no additionalProperties:false) — allOf composition requires each branch to tolerate fields the other branches add; closed-world checks belong in the per-contract schemas that apply this foundation.
$comment: PREDICATE valid_isMarketplace(artifact) := requiredFields(artifact) ∧ deprecationRegistry(artifact) ∧ securityChecks(artifact) ∧ disclosureMarkers(artifact). Monotone in tier; order-independent. See plan 033 § 14.A (predicate) + § 14.10 (4-fold decomposition). Co-located changelogs: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md.

requiredFields.$comment: FOLD 1/4 — the IS marketplace 8-field required set. Evolves under ISEDC Class-1 ratification only (SCHEMA_CHANGELOG NON-NEGOTIABLES item 1). CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § requiredFields. v1.0.0-draft.

deprecationRegistry.$comment: FOLD 2/4 — field-deprecation migrations. Evolves via autonomous validator patch (NON-NEGOTIABLES item 6). A present deprecated key fails the fold; the message names the replacement. CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § deprecationRegistry. v1.0.0-draft: compatible-with → compatibility; when_to_use → description.

securityChecks.$comment: FOLD 3/4 — supply-chain hardening (CISO-driven). name must not be a reserved word and must not contain XML angle brackets; description must not contain XML tags or shell-substitution sequences. CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § securityChecks. v1.0.0-draft.

disclosureMarkers.$comment: FOLD 4/4 — progressive disclosure / token-economy (Karpathy-axis). description is bounded to a token budget (1536 chars). Only strings are constrained (non-strings pass — type is enforced by the per-contract schema, not this foundation). CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § disclosureMarkers. v1.0.0-draft.

isMarketplace.$comment: COMPOSITION — allOf of the four folds. Adding/removing a fold is an architectural change requiring ISEDC review. CHANGELOG: schemas/authoring/v1/CHANGELOG.md § isMarketplace (composition). v1.0.0-draft.
